thread:
noah: Vendor sent an embargoed advisory about an HSM firmware edge that can corrupt attestation blobs for certain BYOK signing paths. Need rapid triage: RBAC, audit exports, and KMS fallback options. Who can take this?
anya: DM the advisory? public yet or limited disclosure?
noah: Sent DM with repro. Vendor claims exploit requires operator console access but treat as high-risk until proven. Customer hit an attestation mismatch after a firmware update.
reza: Ops mitigations: disable auto-firmware on affected clusters, bump audit level for Wrap/Unwrap/Attest, snapshot attestation blobs and export to secure vault, tag keys for expedited rewrap.
ops-bot: ALERT: 2 wrap/unwrap attempts from a single principal detected on hsm-prod-eu within 7s. Incident created: #6501234568 :rotating_light:
anya: RBAC quick fix: list principals with both WrapKey and ExportKey and apply a short deny for ExportKey; enable JIT for hsm-admins. I can run an IAM+log correlation sweep.
noah: Quick log query example for wrap events:
```
resource.type="cloud_hsm_key" protoPayload.methodName="WrapKey"
```
Run it against prod-eu and prod-us to correlate principals.
sec-bot: Reminder: follow BYOK incident runbook and notify Legal/Compliance if any affected keys protect regulated data. Link: https://redwood-internal/security/incident-byok
noah: Draft customer note suggestion: "We're investigating an HSM firmware integrity anomaly affecting attestation for some BYOK flows. We currently have no evidence of key extraction. As a precaution we can offer rewrap to vetted hardware and provide a full audit package. To opt in, contact support@redwood.com." Thoughts?
reza: Include optional forensic timeline and operator-entitlement summary if customer requests. If vendor confirms operator-level exploitability call out operator scopes in the notice.
anya: Scan finished; DM'd results to Noah. Found 1 principal with Wrap+Export in prod-eu. Logs and attestation blobs uploaded to secure-share (marked sensitive).
noah: Great. @reza please open RBAC PR to deny export and add JIT for hsm-admin. @anya prepare rewrap playbook and collect attestation chains for affected keys. Warroom in 30.
ops-bot: Incident #6501234568 severity set to P2; triage in-progress.
